scripts.dev: concurrently --names "server,client" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && cd server && npx prisma generate && npx tsc
scripts.start: cd server && npx prisma db push && node dist/index.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
